system.description: The raksha can incorporate some type of natural weaponry into his form--fangs, claws, horns, a forked tongue, a stinging tail, etc.--that he can use to supplement an unarmed Martial Arts attack. When the player chooses the weapon, he divides the raksha's Essence up among the weapon's Accuracy, Defense, Damage (which is lethal) and Rate. As the raksha's Essence improves, he may continue to improve his natural weapon's traits. The weapon's Speed is always 5. Players can purchase this Charm up to once per dot of the raksha's Sword. Each time the player takes this Charm, he can add an additional weapon or add his Essence again to improve the quality of an existing one.
